summary: Flutter Entertainment plc filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, announcing the completion of the cancellation of its secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange and the Official List of the UK Financial Conduct Authority, effective that day at 08:00 UK time. The company maintains its primary NYSE listing under ticker FLUT. This follows a prior announcement on June 12, 2026. Shareholders are directed to FAQs on the company's website. This is a voluntary delisting from a secondary exchange, not a going-private transaction, with no price or premium involved. What to watch: liquidity impact and shareholder transition to NYSE.
